text: Come, follow me, and I will send you out to fish for people.
Lord, we have left everything to follow you. A patrol blocks the shore ahead!
Woman, why do you involve me? My hour has not yet come.
Romans, at a wedding feast? Lord, they mean to stir up trouble.
Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
They do not welcome you here, brother. Stand ready, all of you.
Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again, but not the water I give.
Lord, the garrison here has no love for travelers on this road.
I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me will live, even though they die.
The road to Jerusalem grows darker from here, Lord. Let us not be afraid.
(Approaches Jesus with a kiss) Here's the man you want, Romans.
Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?
Judas, how could you do this? We trusted you.
This is a dark day for us all. We must stay strong.
We must not let this act of betrayal break our spirits.
Lord, should we strike with our swords?
“No more of this!” (He heals the wounded and calms the crowd)
Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come with swords and clubs? 53 Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. But this is your hour—when darkness reigns.
